bull_bear.body:
- Deleveraging at the standalone level: "Higher cost borrowings (long term + short term) at standalone level have reduced to Rs. 314 crores as on 31st March 2026 as against Rs. 350 crores during 31st March 2025."
- Consolidated balance sheet shows Equity of Rs 1,342 Cr (Mar-26) vs Rs 1,482 Cr (Mar-25); current borrowings Rs 918 Cr vs Rs 929 Cr and non-current borrowings Rs 20 Cr vs Rs 8 Cr; cash and cash equivalents Rs 374 Cr vs Rs 499 Cr.
- Cash flow statement shows Net Cash from Operating Activities of Rs 87 Cr (Mar-26) vs Rs -0.24 Cr, Investing Rs -0.14 Cr vs Rs -35 Cr, and Financing Rs -278 Cr vs Rs 202 Cr.
- No dividend, buyback or stated capital-allocation policy appears anywhere in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Deck claims "Worlds # 1 LCL Consolidator (14% market share)", footnoted "As per internal estimates", alongside Global Neutral FCL, Air Freight, D2D services and Value Added Services across Europe, Americas, APAC and ISC & MEA.
- Scale markers stated: 35+ years of expertise, 2400+ direct trade lanes, 3800+ employees and 200+ own offices across 60+ countries.
- Core business strengths listed as a Digital First approach, a Leading Single Brand Global Network, End to End Logistics, and "Local Expertise, Globally".
- Operating brand for the network and most of the leadership team is ECU Worldwide (regional CEOs for Europe, North America, LATAM, MEA, North Asia, ISC & SEA and China).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] The deck carries demerger artefacts: "Professional fees towards de-merger" of Rs 4 Cr among FY26 one-off costs, and a balance-sheet line of Equity Share Capital Rs 197 Cr at Mar-26 against "Equity Shares Issuable Pursuant to Demerger" Rs 197 Cr at Mar-25. The deck does not describe the demerger itself.
- [FY26 one-offs] Deck bridges Profit before tax of Rs -283 Cr to an "Adjusted Profit before tax" of Rs -47 Cr by adding back: severance and other one time staff restructuring 32, write off of past investment and associated losses 29, professional fees towards de-merger 4, one off PDD 73, payment related to prior period 33, notional forex loss 47, and other non-recurring costs 18 (all Rs Cr, deck's own total quoted, not recomputed).
- [Non-cash framing] Management states many of the FY26 one-off and exceptional costs were non-cash and notional in nature, the real cash impact being staff restructuring and optimisation expenses.
- [Governance] Board is founder-led (Shashi Kiran Shetty, Founder & Chairman; Adarsh Hegde, MD; Vaishnav Shetty, Deputy MD) with four Non-Executive Independent Directors named.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: Allcargo Global positions itself as the world's #1 LCL consolidator (14% market share, as per internal estimates) running a single-brand global network in international supply chain, adding neutral FCL, air freight and door-to-door value-added services across 60+ countries.
